notes.title: Gotta love those day 2 patches
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone, it's been one day since we went live on Steam! Hope you've all been enjoying yourselves and your lawns are looking glorious!

We've just pushed a patch that adds in crosshairs! This should make it easier to tell what grass you're actually looking at, making the game a bit easier to play. The crosshairs are optional, so if you decide you don't like them, or are just a masochist, they can be turned off from the Options crates behind you.

Thanks to @TheNeeGee for the feature suggestion!

Keep 'em growing!
